summary: Iteration 2 focused on the new self-host VPS + in-app updates feature. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed on /app/backend/tests/test_system_and_server.py — GET /api/system/version returns {supported:false} with auth; POST /api/system/update → 400 (self-hosted only); PUT /api/system/auto-update {enabled:true} → 400; all three return 401 without token. Regression smoke green: login PIN 3366, GET /api/groups, GET /api/dashboard. Frontend: 11/11 UI checkpoints passed on 390x844 web preview — PIN screen shows pin-server-button; opens server-sheet with pin-server-url-input; closes via sheet-close-button; login with 3366 → home; home has NO update-banner (correct for unsupported env); Settings → 'Server & Updates' section shows updates-card with 'sirf self-hosted VPS install' message and server-card with server-url-input/server-url-reset/server-url-save; entering https://invalid.example.invalid + Save & re-login correctly switched base URL, logged out, and returned to PIN screen; opening server sheet on PIN, clearing URL, and Save reset to default; login 3366 succeeded again and home rendered. Preview app URL restored to empty/default at test end. Only console warnings observed (shadow* and pointerEvents deprecations) — same as iteration 1, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' (RN-Web warning). Not a runtime error — same as iteration 1.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (RN-Web warning). Same as iteration 1.

action_items: No functional fixes required — the self-host VPS support and in-app update feature works end-to-end in the preview 'unsupported' mode as designed.
(Optional, carried over) Migrate remaining shadow* style props → boxShadow and pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: system.py: supported() gate is correct — REPO_DIR/.git + UPDATER_DIR required, so preview correctly returns {supported:false}.
server.py protected routes for /system/version, /system/update, /system/auto-update correctly enforce auth (401) and 400 on unsupported.
auth.tsx setServerUrl persists via storage, resets base URL, and calls logout() — verified in UI: after save the user is redirected to PIN and queryClient is cleared.
UpdateBanner.tsx correctly returns null when !supported → home never shows the banner in preview.
PIN screen server sheet (index.tsx) autoFocus + Field + Sheet integration works cleanly; sheet-close-button dismisses without saving.
seed_data_creation: None. Server URL was temporarily set to https://invalid.example.invalid then reset to empty/default at end of test — preview app remains usable.
